from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by sex
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')

# 2. Survival rate by class
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=['#99ff99', '#ffcc99', '#ff99cc'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Class')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_ylim(0, 1)

# 3. Age distribution
axes[0, 2].hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=10, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count')

# 4. Fare distribution by class
for cls in df['class'].unique():
    class_data = df[df['class'] == cls]['fare']
    axes[1, 0].hist(class_data, alpha=0.6, label=cls, bins=5)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# 5. Embarkation town distribution
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].pie(embark_counts.values, labels=embark_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Town')

axes[1, 2].set_title('Overall Survival Count')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count')
